name: North Dakota Department of Environmental Quality, Division of Air Quality public comment notices
what: Read every current notice (each facility anchor points at a PDF under deq.nd.gov/AQ/Notices/) and list every gas or oil fired generator, turbine or engine permit of 50 MW or more, including data center backup fleets, campus and industrial plants. Use the harvested index in work/permits/us-nd/ from harvest_permits_northdakota.py.

name: Past Division of Air Quality notices, enumerated through the Wayback Machine
what: The live notices directory refuses listing, so use the Wayback CDX prefix enumeration (and the older ndhealth.gov/AQ/Notices/ prefix) the harvester runs, read every power facility's past notices back to 2020, and record each permit that gives unit lists, megawatts, make and model or dates for a GEM plant or for a plant GEM lacks.

name: Department of Environmental Quality general public notices and feed
what: Read the general notice page and the RSS feed for any power or data center item the Air Quality page misses.

name: CERIS-ND environmental data portal
what: Search each GEM plant and each unmatched power facility by name for permits and documents. The public notices list endpoint answers anonymously; site search needs a session. Record what route worked or that every route failed, with what was tried.

name: North Dakota Public Service Commission case search
what: Use batches/us-nd/harvest/psc_dockets.md from harvest_psc_northdakota.py, then search by entity for anything it missed: Basin Electric (Bison, PU-25-086; Pioneer; the eastern plant deadline PU-24-342), Minnkota (Harmony Township plant, Agassiz PU-26-022, ten-year plan PU-26-254), Otter Tail, Montana-Dakota (Heskett, PU-26-219 and PU-26-236 Center), Northern States Power, Great River Energy, Applied Digital (PU-26-155, PU-24-359, PU-24-330, PU-26-173), Nakota, Base Electron, Rainbow Energy (PU-21-325), NextEra, Cerilon (PU-23-325), Geronimo, and every case filed from 2024-01-01 on.

name: Public Service Commission case documents
what: Read the filings of every matched case (letters of intent, applications, orders, testimony) with pdftotext and cite the document, not the case page, for megawatts, unit counts, dates and owners.

name: Public Service Commission siting page and letters of intent
what: Read the siting page for letters of intent and certificate applications for generating plants of 50 MW or more that have no case number yet.

name: Southwest Power Pool generator interconnection active queue
what: Use batches/us-nd/harvest/queues.md from pull_queues.py --state ND and list every gas or oil entry in North Dakota (GEN-2024-081 and 082 Bison, ERAS-2025-011 and 012 River Run, GEN-2022-083, 010 and 009 Pioneer, GEN-2020-014 Lonesome Creek and any others), then chase each one to a primary document. A queue entry at or above 50 MW that GEM lacks is a new plant at announced.

name: Midcontinent Independent System Operator generator interconnection queue
what: Use the MISO part of batches/us-nd/harvest/queues.md and list every gas or oil entry in North Dakota (J3163 Northern States Power 481 MW Cass County, S1036 Great River Energy 400 MW McLean County, J1193 Heskett withdrawn) and every blank-state entry whose transmission owner is a North Dakota utility, then chase each one to a primary document.

name: EIA-860M newest monthly generator file
what: Read the Operating, Planned and Canceled or Postponed sheets for North Dakota in the newest file, account for every gas or oil plant of 50 MW or more that GEM does not list, and record Bison's EIA plant ID 69071 and its four planned generators.

name: EIA-860 annual survey, ownership and plant tables
what: Read the newest annual Ownership and Plant tables for North Dakota to confirm owners, shares and street addresses of gas and oil plants, especially Heskett, Spiritwood, Pioneer and Lonesome Creek.

name: Basin Electric Power Cooperative news and project pages
what: Read the news center and the project pages for Bison Generation Station, Pioneer, Lonesome Creek and the River Run agreement with NextEra for dates, megawatts, turbine make and model and construction milestones.

name: Minnkota Power Cooperative news and resource plan
what: Read the news pages and the integrated resource plan for the Harmony Township gas plant (400 MW, Cass County, 2031 to 2032) and any other gas generation, and cite Minnkota's own release for the add.

name: Otter Tail Power resource plan and news
what: Read the resource plan and news for gas generation in North Dakota, including any plant tied to the Geronimo Power data center in Harmony Township.

name: Montana-Dakota Utilities resource plan and news
what: Read the 2024 North Dakota integrated resource plan and news for Heskett Station and any new gas unit, and confirm the owner source the validation report says is missing.

name: Great River Energy news and Spiritwood pages
what: Read the news and Spiritwood Station pages for the owner, location and carbon capture sources the validation report says are missing, and for the McLean County surplus interconnection entry.

name: Xcel Energy and Northern States Power plans and news
what: Read the Upper Midwest resource plan and news for the North Dakota combustion turbine (MISO J3163, Cass County, 481 MW) and confirm Xcel Fargo stays cancelled.

name: Possible updates sheet, North Dakota rows
what: Read the gas and oil plants tab through the work profile for every North Dakota row and answer each one in a record or a coverage note.

name: Data center campuses and flare-gas sites with on-site or dedicated gas generation
what: Answer every North Dakota data center campus announced since 2024 (Applied Digital Ellendale and Harwood, Nakota Williston, Base Electron Center, Geronimo Harmony Township, any Fargo or Grand Forks campus) and every flare-gas generation site, for on-site gas turbines, gas or diesel engine fleets (backup fleets included) or a utility gas plant built for it. A fleet whose summed electrical nameplate reaches 50 MW, or one with generators and no usable rating, is a new plant (briefs/_data_centers.md).
